task.title: Implement safe supervised source due-state reconciliation

scope.owned_layer: source-ingest desired-state reconciliation, provider execution boundary, bounded scheduling policy, SourceHealth outcome truth, and source-lane regression proof
scope.not_changing: root deployment profile wiring, external-egress authority, live broker authority, frontend surfaces, or unrelated loop controllers

reconcile_and_pull.egress_posture: deny by default; exact host allowlist required for external access

cross_process_safety.reconcile_transaction: process-shared exclusive file lock across requirement admission and connector/schedule convergence
cross_process_safety.jsonl_mutations: refresh durable log while holding a stable sidecar exclusive file lock
cross_process_safety.frontier_claim: enqueue dedupe and claim transition are each atomic against the latest shared frontier
cross_process_safety.execution_owner: only the durable frontier claimant may create the ingest run and SourceRecord

acceptance.requirement: Persona source requirement creates or updates connector and schedule without manual calls
Scheduled reconciliation remains supervised while provider pulls remain bounded and allowlisted
proof: reconcile_only rejects provider connector selection and provider-side effects
reconcile_and_pull rejects zero/unbounded and greater-than-24 tick configurations
run-scheduled rejects max concurrency above the configured supervisor limit

acceptance.requirement: Duplicate ticks and two workers create no duplicate schedule or SourceRecord
Missed ticks recover after restart and connector failures remain isolated
SourceHealth reports policy denial credentials provider failure and success truthfully

validation.result: 3 normalized TWSE tw_price_daily SourceRecords; max_records=3; connector concurrency=1
